title: OMO Laundry Liquid 6.6l Ultimate $35.99, Active Clean $27.99 @ Costco (Membership Required)
body:
Deal: OMO Laundry Liquid 6.6l Ultimate $35.99, Active Clean $27.99 @ Costco (Membership Required)

[AyTrain] Hey OP can you please share the upcoming catalogue?
[crazynic] https://viewer.joomag.com/in-warehouse-savings-31-08-26-27-0…
[jhalajd] received promo/marketing email from Costco
[SeanConnery] Anyone used both Active & Ultimate? Worth the extra money for Ultimate?
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Just don't buy sensitive. It's shit. We bought it for probably 10yrs and then finally switched to ultimate and realised how much cleaner it is
[tenpercent] I just want one that works well and doesn't stink to high heaven of fragrance. I assume the fragrance isn't improving the cleaning.
[daanish] According to the recent Choice results Omo Ultimate was the best rated liquid.
https://www.choice.com.au/home-and-living/laundry-and-cleani…
The choice results don't include the Kirkland Liquid though but I would be interested to know how that stacks up as it's quite a reasonable price at $18.99 for 5.73L ($3.31/L)
[h0mbre] I used Ultimate exclusively for a long time until trying the Kirkland liquid and have been using it ever since.
I feel its comparable or better and my wife is the same and that's the opinion that matters in this scenario.
I will note that Kirkland stopped selling the Made in USA and sells a Made in China version now (Ultraclean Tough).
We are on our 4th bottle of that now I think and it's still good, can't really tell any noticeable difference to be honest and the price can't be argued with.
[Lucille Bluth] My local IGA has the ultimate 6.6l for $24.99 as a managers special. Maybe check your local as not all deals happen across IGA stores
[SlipperyNip] Awesome I'll grab a top up, my wife likes to keep one in the front window as a spare 👌
[MeesusEff] Since its Costco might as well get the Kirkland red one, ¢19 for 5.xL
